steps.t: Turn on HUD notifications for the Criminal Profile and progress counters.
The morning after Down to Earth, meditate with Lucia on the balcony; keep a Chapter 1 save.
Out-fish Cal after Feng Shui and start Kenton's dives after Island Dreams.
Scan every vehicle and animal you pass with WAiNK and the binoculars.
Do Kirk's Skunk Ape nights and Shirley's Chapter 1 errands while they exist.
Save at the start and end of every chapter; there is no mission replay.

stages.title: Chapters 1-2: story and the one early risk

steps.t: Play Race Against Yago the moment it appears, and every timed call.
Start Andy (Lucia), Tyrone (Jason), Randy and Bret as soon as they unlock.
Rob three jewelry stores with your partner, then one quietly with the Snap Gun.
Start the Chapter 4 vault mission and escape a 4-star chase together.
Train Strength with your partner; finish partner trophies before the finale.
Keep an untouched save before the final mission: endings differ.

stages.title: Chapters 3-5: heists, side strands and partner trophies

steps.t: Unfog the map by plane first: it reveals activity and robbery icons.
Shooting range golds, drone locations, 20 race wins, 250 stunts.
One-offs: airliner at VCIA, tank at Mile Zero, Banshee showroom, Ocean View martini, UFO, Ten Pin.
Buy the 8 garages, register 10 cars, spend $100k and launder $250k.
Open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion and work the list line by line.
Gang operations (39), vaults (8), bank jobs (22), Payday Loans (7).
Cards (15 sets), WAiNK (100), vehicles (200), animals (100), meditations.
Finish every stranger strand until the counter reads 8.
Re-check counters (meditations 18, Criminal Profile 500) in the trophy list.
The platinum follows the last of the 54.

stages.title: Cleanup: Strangers & Freaks and the platinum
